text:
Luca: Hey team — PR #8579 is ready for review but I'm gating the merge on a short architecture blessing. https://rfc.internal/reports/arch-pr8579-draft (private)
Mei Chen: Can you paste a 2‑line summary here? link won't open for everyone in case of perms.
Luca: TL;DR: change default shard routing to affinity-first with fallback to round-robin when KV cache misses exceed 20%. Could change p95 latency by ~10–20ms under tail load. SLOs still met in perf tests but want arch signoff for rollout plan.
Sam: Can you drop the SLO deltas and test commands? makes it easier to review quickly.
Luca: Sure — perf summary: p50 +2ms, p95 +12ms, cpu GPU cycles +3%. Test commands used:
```
./scripts/loadtest --concurrency 500 --seq-len 256 --duration 10m
```
Also added unit tests for shard affinity logic and an e2e canary job in CI config: `canary/pr8579.yml`.
Jordan: :eyes: Need the RFC anchor, compatibility matrix, and a canary rollback plan in the PR description before I can bless. Also include the KV cache TTL assumptions.
Luca: Added compatibility matrix to RFC (section 3), and updated PR description with rollback steps + `canary/pr8579.yml`. KV cache TTL assumption: 5m default, configurable per-model.
Mei Chen: Quick question — will this affect dedicated pools differently than hosted? if so we need to call that out.
Luca: Dedicated pools: same behavior but routing config is admin-only. Hosted: we flip feature flag per-tenant during canary. I'll add a note in RFC.
Sam: Tests green on staging? deploy-bot reported flaky tests earlier.
deploy-bot: CI: build passed, staging e2e partially flaky (2/10 runs failed on timeout). Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/8579
Luca: Acknowledged — investigating the two flaky runs. Not related to routing change (timeout in unrelated downstream call) but I'll re-run canary after fix.
Jordan: If you can add a 1-paragraph risk summary in the PR and set a 2hr canary window with automated rollback on error rate >0.5%, I can give a lightweight arch bless.
Luca: Will do. Adding risk summary + canary policy. Ping me when updated and I'll review asap. :thumbsup:
Mei Chen: Thanks. Also tag me in the PR for quick latency eyeballs once you have the canary results.
Luca: Tagged you. Running a fresh staging run now, will post results in this thread.
Sam: Appreciate the follow-ups — once Jordan blesses, schedule merge in the next 1hr release window so we can observe.
Luca: Staging run finished: all e2e passed (5/5), perf run stable. Updated PR description and RFC with canary policy. Ready for arch check.
Jordan: Reviewing now. If nothing surprising I will leave a comment + :white_check_mark: within 20m.
Mei Chen: :eyes: I'll glance over latency dashboards after Jordan's bless.
Jordan: Left comment and gave a lightweight arch bless. "LGTM from arch assuming canary window and rollback policy included" :white_check_mark:
Luca: Thanks everyone — merging in the 15:00 release window. Will monitor latency and post a follow-up in #incidents if anything shows up. :rocket:
